Two things worth knowing before you write, because they rule some ideas out:

- **VoidSteps makes no network requests.** No accounts, no server, no telemetry,
  no streaming, no cloud anything. Multi-device sync is expected to return later
  as a separate paid feature, but nothing else crosses the network.
- **Free is the complete app.** Nothing is gated behind a tier.
